answer: What keeps this honest is humming frequency profile, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 779 aliases would need 779 separate proofs, each costing about 113 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. A beacon of doubt is healthy, a delta of proof is required, and a vault of patience is the price of a clean panel. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
